title: Ceilings (MF)
activity: MF ceilings, bulkheads and access panels
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Are perimeter channels at the correct fixing type and centres, and aligned?
Are hanger fixings suitable for the substrate (pull-out tested where required)?
Furring channel at the correct centres, no unsupported spans?
Air temperature between +5°C and +30°C while boarding and jointing?
MEP in the void complete and tested before boarding?
Are boards lightly butted, screws at ≤150 mm centres, no unsupported joints?
Are bulkheads, grille openings and access panels in the right positions?
Is the finished ceiling level, joints aligned and free from damage?
